pages.title: Puppy Paw Match
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Connect matching puppies or toys in Puppy Paw Match. Build groups of three or more to clear them and work toward the level goal. Use bombs or boosters when a section is hard to clear. Try events such as Hit the Box, Coin Catch, and Time Attack as they become available.

pages.title: MycoThreeMemo
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Find sets of three mushrooms from the same species in MycoThreeMemo. Remember where you've seen each specimen and compare its features carefully, since two mushrooms of the same species can look different. Work quickly enough to finish the sets before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Dress Up Outfit Match
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Sort clothes and put together looks in Dress Up Outfit Match. Look at the available garments and decide which pieces belong together before you commit to a choice. Work through the outfit puzzles and makeover challenges, using the clothing options to build a different look as you go.

pages.title: Kitty Match 3 puzzle game
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Clear groups of three or more identical cat tiles in Kitty Match 3 puzzle game. Check the goal before choosing a move, since each level limits how many moves you have. Look for matches that set up another combination as the board changes and use those combos to raise your score.

pages.title: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Tap to earn points in Goo Goo Gaga Clicker. Spend them on upgrades that make each click worth more or bring in points automatically. Make the most of temporary multipliers when they appear. Keep improving your earnings to unlock all ten forms in the collection.

pages.title: Monster Slayers
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Survive waves of monsters on your own in Monster Slayers. Steer your hero away from crowds as you work through each run and build up the character for tougher fights. Use the arrow keys, WASD, or the mouse on desktop, or move with the onscreen thumbstick when playing by touch.

pages.title: Grandma's Last Stand
pages.creator: DAВ3Games
pages.description: Get Granny home through a zombie chase in Grandma's Last Stand. Choose weapons before the fight, then switch between them as enemies close in on motorcycles and in cars. Watch for drones and rocket launchers while you fight back with everything from a revolver to a bazooka.

pages.title: Draw Weapon Fight Party
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Sketch a weapon before entering the arena in Draw Weapon Fight Party. Use the available ink to draw the shape you want, then take it into a 3D fight. Check how much ink remains while you draw. Try a different design to see how it changes the way you fight.

pages.title: Fruit Mahjong 3D
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Rotate a three-dimensional tile layout in Fruit Mahjong 3D. Find two free tiles with the same fruit and match them to remove the pair. Turn the board to check which pieces are blocked from another angle. Use the hint or shuffle option if you run out of matches you can see.

pages.title: World Z Defense - Zombie Defense
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Deploy soldiers to hold off zombies in World Z Defense - Zombie Defense. Compare weapon range, damage, and reload speed before placing a defender. Soldiers return to the base to reload, so account for that pause when setting up your line. Earn coins from waves and spend them on base upgrades.

pages.title: Number Master
pages.creator: MetaVector
pages.description: Remove number pairs in Number Master. Match two identical values or pick two numbers that add up to ten. Look for more than one possible partner before choosing what to clear. The puzzles take place in a bamboo forest with pandas, and each match changes the numbers left on the board.

pages.title: Car Parking Stunt Games 2024
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Drive a car along elevated stunt tracks in Car Parking Stunt Games 2024. Use WASD to guide the vehicle and judge the space you have before turning or lining up with the next stretch. Keep the car under control through the narrow sections as you take on the driving and parking challenges.

pages.title: Monster Collect Run
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Collect crystals and ammunition as you run in Monster Collect Run. Use the projectiles you pick up against the creatures waiting ahead. Defeat a monster more than once to learn its weaknesses and capture it. Then play as the captured creature and see how it handles the next fight.

pages.title: Window Jump Guy
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Launch a character from a window in Window Jump Guy. Use the mouse or touch and try to carry the jump all the way to the finish. Climb to higher floors for another attempt and see how far you can go. The jumps involve spins as well as distance.

pages.title: BlockFit Puzzler
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Remove blocks from the upper layer in BlockFit Puzzler until it matches the pattern underneath. Use the angled view to compare the two layers and work out which blocks should stay. The layouts range from three by three to five by five, giving you more positions to check as you advance.

pages.title: Bouncy Motors
pages.creator: Mewton Games
pages.description: Drive a jelly-like car to the finish in Bouncy Motors. Move forward or backward and rotate the car to manage its landings. Keep the wheels away from red zones, which can knock them off, and take care when the route crosses ice. Use the bounce to get through the next obstacle.

pages.title: Aqua Fish Dental Care
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Treat underwater patients in Aqua Fish Dental Care. Use the mouse to select and handle dental equipment as you work through each visit. Different aquatic species appear from one level to the next. Complete the care steps for the current patient before seeing who needs treatment next.

pages.title: Studio's Pupil
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Build a music business in Studio's Pupil. Produce tracks and decide where to invest the income, from speeding up production to improving marketing. As the studio grows, keep an eye on expenses as well as earnings. Walk around the studio and use the upgrade controls when you're ready to expand.

pages.title: Halloween Skeleton Smash
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive a van through crowds of skeletons in Halloween Skeleton Smash. Use the arrow keys or mouse to change direction at speed. Some skeletons damage the van when you hit them, so look at what's in your path before steering into a group. Keep driving and see how many you can smash.

pages.title: Poppy Huggie Escape
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Run, jump, and slide to escape in Poppy Huggie Escape. Gather all the keys you need for the doors while keeping ahead of the chaser. Use the arrow keys or touch gestures to get around obstacles. Spend your score in the shop to unlock other chasers for future runs.

pages.title: Super Cute Cat
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Hunt mutated cats and find the key in Super Cute Cat. Guide your cat with WASD or the touch controls and collect candies along the way. Deal with the enemies before you head for the exit. Use the key to advance to the next level and take on its new layout.

pages.title: Furtive Dao
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Help a red panda raise money for a shelter in Furtive Dao. Use the mouse or touch to work through action puzzles with six different types of enemies. Plan how to get past each threat while making progress toward the shelter's goal. There are 30 levels to solve.

pages.title: Birdy Trick
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fly a small bird past larger birds in Birdy Trick. Watch where the next obstacle is moving and guide your bird into a gap before the two paths meet. Keep looking ahead as more hazards appear. See how far you can get without running into one.

pages.title: Neon Circles & Color Sort Puzzle
pages.creator: Yc Games
pages.description: Line up rings of the same color in Neon Circles & Color Sort Puzzle. Look at the colors already on the board before choosing where to place the next hoops. Use the trash can to change rings when the current ones give you a poor fit. Keep making matches to raise your score.

pages.title: Word Hunter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find hidden words and drag across their letters in Word Hunter. Work through the grid and look for words from different subjects and industries. When you spot one, highlight the whole word in a single drag. See how quickly you can recognize the next entry and complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Bullet Man 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Line up a shot at moving targets in Bullet Man 3D. Watch where the enemy is headed before you fire, since a bullet aimed at their current spot may miss. Take a moment to choose the angle that gives you a clear shot. Time the trigger so the target crosses the bullet's path.

pages.title: Hangman
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Guess letters and solve hidden words in Hangman. Play against the computer or share the game with up to three friends. Use each correct letter to narrow down the answer before you guess again. The player who works out the most words comes out ahead.

pages.title: Stair Run
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a path upward to get around obstacles in Stair Run. Use the drag controls and plan where the next stretch of steps will help you clear a hazard. Use the pieces you have where they give you enough height. Keep working toward the top as the route changes.

pages.title: Adopt a Pet Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Rebuild 12 pictures about welcoming pets into a home in Adopt a Pet Jigsaw. Drag the pieces into place and use the animals and background details to find where they belong. Look for lines and colors that continue across the edges. Finish one adoption scene and choose another to assemble.

pages.title: Princess Stewardess
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Get Princess Emma ready to work as a flight attendant in Princess Stewardess. Start with her spa treatment and then choose makeup, an outfit, and accessories for her new job. Compare the options as you go. Finish the look before Emma heads to work.

pages.title: Real oil Tanker Simulator Mania
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Drive a tanker along hills and city roads in Real oil Tanker Simulator Mania. Use the arrow keys to steer the truck as you transport oil to filling stations. Give the vehicle room to turn and keep it steady on the climbs. Bring the tanker to its destination to complete the delivery.

pages.title: Conect The Same Number
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Draw lines between identical numbers in Conect The Same Number. Leave room for other pairs because the paths cannot cross. Drag backward along a line if you need to remove it and try another route. Start in Normal mode or choose Maniac mode for a harder puzzle.

pages.title: Patterns Link
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear a board of patterned tiles in Patterns Link. Click matching designs to link them and look again after a pair disappears. A tile that was hard to reach may have a clear route once its neighbors are gone. Work quickly and keep linking pairs until the board is empty.

pages.title: Virus Ninja
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Swipe through the spreading viruses in Virus Ninja. Use the mouse or your finger to slice them as they cross the play area. Watch where several are headed so you can catch more than one in a swipe. Keep reacting as fresh targets come into view.

pages.title: Fast Fingers
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Drag your character out of the way of falling blocks in Fast Fingers. Watch where the blocks are coming down and move into the open space before they reach you. Keep scanning above the character as the gaps shift. See how long you can dodge and try to beat your best score.

pages.title: Extreme Thumb War
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose from more than twenty thumb characters in Extreme Thumb War. Take on the computer or a friend and watch both the health and power bars. Time your attacks while you still have power to press your opponent. Play using touch controls or W and Up on the keyboard.

pages.title: Popular War
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Gather a crowd and grow it by taking followers from other players in Popular War. Click to send your leader across the map and look for people you can bring along. Build up your group before challenging another player. Pull away their followers to eliminate them and make your crowd larger.

pages.title: Crazy Racing Planes Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Find pairs of plane pictures in Crazy Racing Planes Memory. Turn over two tiles and remember where you saw each plane if they don't match. Use those positions to find the partners later. Clear all four levels and see how few moves you can use to match every picture.

pages.title: Yellow Roses Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble images of anime girls with yellow roses in Yellow Roses Puzzle. Choose one of six pictures and a puzzle size of 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the flowers and surrounding details to work out how the edges line up. Try a larger version if you want a harder arrangement.

pages.title: Real Bike Racing Game 2019
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Race motorcycles in Real Bike Racing Game 2019. Choose a superbike and watch where the other riders are as you take on the course. Look through the turn before moving past a rival and use the rear-view mirrors to see what's behind you. Try another bike to compare how it handles.

pages.title: Retro Animal Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Put together retro-style animal pictures in Retro Animal Jigsaw. Choose from 12 images and solve the puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Match shapes and details along the edges of the pieces to rebuild the scene. Choose a larger piece count to revisit the picture at a higher difficulty.

pages.title: FoosBall Funny
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Play table soccer against the computer or a friend in FoosBall Funny. Use your players to send the ball toward the opposing goal and cover your own end when possession changes. Watch where the ball goes after each hit. Create a clear shot when you can get past the defenders.

pages.title: Ancient Samurai Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Unlock samurai scenes one at a time in Ancient Samurai Jigsaw. Start with the first image and assemble its pieces to open the next. There are 12 pictures and three modes, with 25, 49, or 100 pieces per puzzle. Use details from the figures and backgrounds to place the pieces.

pages.title: Dinosaur Warrior Coloring
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Color eight dinosaur pictures in Dinosaur Warrior Coloring. Pick a drawing and choose a palette for the dinosaur and the details around it. Try another color when you want to change a part of the picture. Click the camera when you're done to download the result.

pages.title: Tower Jump
pages.creator: 8Fat.com
pages.description: Tap to jump as you work around the tower in Tower Jump. Twist the tower to find a route past the stacked obstacles. Look ahead before jumping so you can tell where the next open space will be. Make it past the stack and reach the destination to finish.

pages.title: Helix Smash
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Break through a tower of stacked platforms in Helix Smash. Time your descent so the ball smashes through sections it can break, and ease off when a dangerous section is in the way. Watch the layer below before you commit to another drop. Get through the stack to move on.

pages.title: EG Viking Escape
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Fly a dragon out of a dark forest in EG Viking Escape. Help the Viking get past goblins and other creatures by throwing weapons or breathing fire with the dragon. Collect ammunition and points along the way. Keep the dragon flying until you reach the far end of the woods.

pages.title: Clocks
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Watch the arrow turn in Clocks and tap when it lines up with the next clock. Take the shot promptly because waiting lowers the points you earn. Work through 100 quest levels or try Survival mode to see how long you can keep the sequence going.

pages.title: Bear Run
pages.creator: stoneye
pages.description: Tap to jump over obstacles in Bear Run. Watch the route as Mr. Bear runs forward and time your jumps to clear what's in front of him. Collect coins when they're on a safe path. Keep the run going to cover more distance and improve your score.

pages.title: Legend of the Samurai
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Run from a demon in Legend of the Samurai. Help the samurai avoid obstacles, collect points, and break through what stands in his path. Watch the route ahead so you can react before something slows him down. Keep moving to stay out of reach of the pursuer.

pages.title: Dots Connect 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Connect points with pipes in Dots Connect 3D. Look at the board from its three-dimensional view and choose routes that reach the matching points. Think ahead about what spaces the other connections will need. Fill the board with pipes to finish the layout.

pages.title: Drawing & Coloring Animals
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Draw and color animal pictures in Drawing & Coloring Animals. Choose tools from the bottom of the screen and use them to add color or lines. Switch to the hand tool to drag the picture, or zoom in when you want to work on a small detail.

pages.title: Pixel Bounce
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Bounce a pixel between walls in Pixel Bounce. Jump as often as you need to change the pixel's route and stay clear of the spikes. Watch the top and bottom of the screen as well as the next wall. A single touch ends the run, so see how long you can keep bouncing.

pages.title: Winter Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a winter drawing and color it in Winter Coloring Book. Pick a shade and use the brush to fill in the parts you want to paint. Build up the scene one section at a time. Try a different picture when you want to work with another set of colors.

pages.title: Ravensworth High School
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Start at a new school as Liz in Ravensworth High School. Follow the visual novel through friendships, family, and romance at Ravensworth Academy. See where your choices take the story and collect stars, hearts, and coins as you go. The school day is only the start of Liz's time there.

pages.title: Super Neon Ball
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Keep a glowing ball jumping on platforms in Super Neon Ball. Watch the next landing spot and guide the ball toward it as you try for a higher score. Collect coins along the way and use them to unlock other balls. Try another run to see how much farther you can go.

pages.title: Gems Glow
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Join gems of the same color in Gems Glow. Draw each connection while leaving enough space for the other colors to reach their partners. The puzzle is finished when the links cover the whole board. Check for empty spaces before deciding that a layout is complete.

pages.title: Susie Goes Skating
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Choose skating costumes for a princess and her daughter in Susie Goes Skating. Put together the mother's outfit first and then dress the younger skater. Give each one a distinct look for the contest. Compare their outfits before they head out onto the ice.

pages.title: Avie Pocket: Birthday
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Plan a birthday for Avie in Avie Pocket: Birthday. Visit the bakery and pick flavors for her cake, then choose an outfit for the party. Take part in the celebration activities after the preparations are done. Bring the cake and the birthday look together for Avie's day.

pages.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Choose a new outfit for a witch in Kiki's Delivery Service. Browse the clothes and try pieces together to see which look suits her. Make changes until you've found the style you want her to wear. Finish dressing her before she takes to the air again.

pages.title: Princess Sorority Sisters
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style Cinderella, Tiana, Rapunzel, and Elsa for recruitment in Princess Sorority Sisters. Choose clothes and accessories to suit the sorority each one wants to join. Try ripped jeans and a printed top for Cinderella, then put together different looks for the other three. Finish all four outfits before recruitment begins.
